messages:
sam: quick check — we're seeing a flurry of client errors on /v2/generate when prompts are huge. current behavior returns 400. should we standardize on a specific status for token-length issues (413 vs 422 vs staying 400)? what do folks think?
rachel: my take: if the payload exceeds a hard service limit, 413 (Payload Too Large) is the most semantically correct. 422 is useful for semantic/validation issues (malformed instructions). 400 = bad shape for generic missing/invalid fields. :thinking:
mike: FYI our client libs currently treat 4xx as non-retryable and only retry on 429/5xx. if we switch to 413 that's still non-retryable, so behavior won't change, but SDKs should expose a machine-readable error_code so apps can adapt.
tara: agreed with rachel. also note streaming endpoints complicate this — if tokens blow up midstream we sometimes ship a midstream termination event. do we unify that with the same status or a separate midstream envelope?
ella: proposal:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "input_too_large",
  "message": "Prompt length 124k tokens exceeds allowed 64k",
  "allowed_tokens": "64000",
  "received_tokens": "124000",
  "retryable": false
}
```
This gives clients the info to truncate client-side and avoid guessing.
sam: that looks good. for backcompat: some older clients will look for 400. do we need a transition plan (e.g., return 400 + error_code for a period, then switch)?
mike: we could dual-return the envelope with the same error_code but move status to 413. most HTTP clients check status first though. Maybe for 3-4 weeks we keep returning 400 but include `error.code = "input_too_large"` and a header `X-Redwood-Deprecated-Status: 400->413` so we can switch cleanly.

achel: alternative: return 413 but vendor a short compatibility header `X-Redwood-Legacy-Status: 400` for older SDKs that parse headers. downside: some clients ignore headers.
tara: I'd rather do the header + error_code approach and announce a hard cutoff. Ops: any objections?
devex: ping @sam — when you open the PR, add a docs snippet and a one-liner for SDKs to map error_code -> non-retry. we'll post a migration guide. :thumbsup:
sam: ok i'll draft PR: update generate handler to return 413 + envelope with `error` and `retryable: false`. we'll include `allowed_tokens` and `received_tokens`. for streaming midstream termination we'll emit an event with same error_code and close with 499/stream-terminated (we'll detail in PR).
ella: small nit — prefer `error` to be a short machine code (snake_case) and `message` for human text. also add `hint` maybe for auto-truncation suggestion.
mike: agree. sample machine code: `input_too_large`.
rachel: thanks — this clears up the contract. once PR is opened, devex can prepare SDK patches.
sam: filing now, will tag this thread. thanks all. :rocket:
